description: Abstract generic base class for persistence entities in a Java application, providing common implementations for identity, equality, hashing, comparison, and string representation, utilizing Hibernate and Java generics.

classes.name: SalesManagerEntity
classes.description: An abstract generic base class for entities with an identifiable key, providing standard methods for entities management, including equality, comparison, and string representation.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the entity.

methods.name: isNew
methods.description: Indicates whether the entity has not yet been persisted (i.e., whether the ID is null).

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare entities based on their ID, with Hibernate class proxy handling.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode to generate hash based on the entity's ID.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this entity with another based on their IDs for ordering.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the entity, including class name and ID.
